It then describes the proposed method: using bidirectional (forward and backward) sphere tracing to narrow the candidate range of surface positions, and subsequently refining the zero-level set using additional solvers (specifically, evaluating samples for zero crossings and performing sectioning steps). All specific details mentioned in the claim are present in the evidence.
